title: (2025 SEP) Cumulative Updates for Business Central
summary: This post lists cumulative updates for Business Central across multiple versions and release waves, including v26 (2025 RW1), v25 (2024 RW2), and v24 (2024 RW1), with links to both cloud and on-premises update resources. It emphasizes installing the latest updates to address hotfixes and security vulnerabilities.
key_points: Cumulative updates replace previously released updates for each version
Update 26.5 for v26, Update 25.11 for v25, and Update 24.17 for v24 are the latest for actively supported versions
Updates include both global hotfixes and localization-specific hotfixes
Older versions (v23 and earlier) are no longer receiving updates

quotes.text: Some updates additionally fix vulnerabilities, so the latest update should always be installed.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the security imperative for applying cumulative updates to maintain system protection

quotes.text: Updates include hotfixes that apply to all countries and hotfixes that apply to specific local versions.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies that updates address both global and localized issues, relevant for multi-region deployments
